game.title: Đua Xe Thú
game.subtitle: Sugarloop Valley Grand Prix
game.tagline: Six critters. Three laps. One very sticky valley.

track.pick.title: Choose a track
track.candy.name: Candy Valley
track.candy.desc: A pastel loop with boost pads and a fluffy shortcut.
track.halloween.name: Halloween Circuit
track.halloween.desc: A purple moon, glowing pumpkins and friendly ghosts.
char.bunny.name: Bunny Thỏ
char.bunny.blurb: Explodes off the line and bounces back from every bump.
char.bear.name: Panda Gấu
char.bear.blurb: A round black-and-white panda who is never afraid of a little bump.
char.tiger.name: Đại Ka Kọp
char.tiger.blurb: Quick as a flash and happiest on the straightaways.
char.chicken.name: Gà Wala
char.chicken.blurb: Tiny, nimble and always ready for a surprise burst.
char.buffalo.name: Ngưu Ma Vương
char.buffalo.blurb: Little horns, steady wheels and a sure line through corners.
char.dog.name: SleepingDog
char.dog.blurb: A loyal little racer with a balanced, nimble kart.
item.shield.desc: Blocks one hit and bumps rivals away.
item.taffy.desc: Drops a sticky blob behind you.
item.bee.desc: Chases the racer right ahead of you.
item.missile.desc: A homing rocket races after the rival ahead.
item.sonic.desc: A sound wave wobbles nearby karts.
item.lightning.desc: A bright bolt jolts the leading rival.
hint.drive.touch: The kart drives itself — drag the stick to steer
hint.drift.touch: Hold DRIFT while steering into a turn
hint.driftRelease: Keep drifting until sparks glow, then let go for a boost
hint.crate: Drive through a Candy Orb to grab an item
hint.shortcut: Tip: the signposted shortcut is fluffy — boost through it!
hint.startBoost: Tip: press gas just as the last light turns on
tutorial.title: How to race
tutorial.tip1: Drift through corners: sparks turn blue, pink, then gold. Release for a boost.
tutorial.tip2: Tap drift in mid-air off a ramp for a trick boost.
